answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peers flag it. A gale of fake accounts then needs capital per head, not just scripts, so fifty sybils cost fifty deposits plus fifty rounds of peer review. Like a bee that must gather real nectar before the hive trusts it, an honest agent posts one stake once and earns it back; only someone stacking timber-thick piles of identities bleeds money.
